task_text: Using the climate tool’s dataset catalogue, identify the dataset for future climate projections and the dataset for seasonal forecasts. Report each dataset identifier and its classification.
ground_truth_scope: Two requested categories in the repository climate tool’s curated catalogue, not exhaustive live CDS holdings.

projections-cmip6.description: CMIP6 climate model projections from multiple modelling centres. Various scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, SSP5-8.5).

seasonal-original-single-levels.description: Copernicus Climate Change Service seasonal forecast data on single levels.

provenance.extraction_method: AST extraction of _CDS_DATASETS; no network request or download.
provenance.refresh_policy: Review GT when the curated catalogue changes.

evaluation_policy.normalization: Ignore order and superficial formatting; accept equivalent classification wording, including climate projections/CMIP6 projections and seasonal predictions/forecasts. Dataset identifiers must resolve to the canonical entries.
evaluation_policy.pairing: Check each identifier with its own classification; swapped labels are incorrect.
evaluation_policy.classification_score: Correct required pairs / 2, on a 0–1 scale; missing pairs count as incorrect.
evaluation_policy.execution_status: GT stored; validator and candidate scoring pending.
evaluation_policy.unrecognized_label_policy: Normalize case/whitespace/punctuation and match explicit aliases. Ambiguous or unrecognized paraphrases require manual adjudication; record unresolved rather than silently using fuzzy/model matching as a deterministic score.
